scientific_question: Whether structural quality and error location/type explain intervention-effect and action-selection performance, rather than valve state prediction alone

model.regime: no Fault, no clipping/stiction/shutdown; branch conditions must be recorded, not silently selected away

nodes.meaning: manual XMV10 external requested command, equals evaluated process command only in admitted manual regime
nodes.time: k, after request and before evaluate

nodes.meaning: reactor energy coordinate; NOT reactor temperature

diagnostics_not_learning_nodes.meaning: actual applied vcv[9] after cache update/clipping
diagnostics_not_learning_nodes.reason: admitted normal regime c=u gives duplicate deterministic columns; record separately and reject violations
algebraic intermediate, explicitly substituted into proposed reduced transition; no new sensor-direct claim

diagnostics_not_learning_nodes.reason: physical target/readout; not an independent state or E synonym

diagnostics_not_learning_nodes.reason: secondary observation readout; must not mix with integrated state clock

diagnostics_not_learning_nodes.reason: manual policy fixed; automatic feedback requires a different contract

finite_comparison_design.interpretation: proposed reduced discrete Euler transition parents, NOT elementary physical edges or a GT
excluded_from_this_universe: lags greater than1 pending valid marginal model; not assumed absent
boundary/readout relationships; excluded by scope, not declared noncausal
finite_comparison_design.unresolved_pair_policy: All12 are unadjudicated for discovery scoring. Do not count conditional exclusions as negatives, unknown as absent, or omit unknown pairs to call a global score.
finite_comparison_design.future_partial_scoring: Only after independently adjudicated positive/negative pairs and matching estimand; report coverage and abstention, never whole-process F1. No eligible subset is approved now.

missing_or_conditioned: cache history, stiction, clipping, source shutdown branch, fixed tau/dt, manual u_eval=u_req
parent_closure.evidence: PR19 actual4steps; general regime not closed by this reduction

missing_or_conditioned: UA from liquid volume and agitator state
T_R from E and reactor composition/holdup

boundaries.meaning: yy[0:8], liquid holdup/composition and vapor pressure inputs
enthalpy flows and reaction heat; aggregate of endogenous states
UA depends on reactor liquid volume and actual agitator valve
no shutdown/clip/stiction and manual command semantics

boundary_policy: Reading or conditioning an endogenous aggregate does not make it an exogenous input. Freezing its future baseline trace under action is a different intervened model. No replay/clamp or residual iid assumption is authorized.

learning_contract.data: proposed privileged internal states, not factory sensors; source default steady trajectory insufficient
learning_contract.c_u_determinism: Do not duplicate c=u as separate discovery columns or add artificial noise to make a method pass
learning_contract.innovation_model: UNJUSTIFIED; adding independent noise changes the simulator model

algorithms.family: static PC-stable/BOSS or static linear LiNGAM
algorithms.estimand: static DAG/equivalence representation, not these reduced dynamic transition parents
algorithms.reason: temporal samples/dependent roots/nonlinear deterministic transitions; no naive row-wise or lag-stacking equivalence

algorithms.estimand: lagged/contemporaneous observed time-series relations under its assumptions
algorithms.reason: closure, finite Markov order/faithfulness, innovations and excitation unestablished

algorithms.estimand: ancestral/PAG projection with latent variables, not elementary update parents
algorithms.reason: no corresponding projected reference/lag/selection contract; cannot score PAG as directed state DAG

learning_contract.settings_rule: Version/test/score/lag/threshold fixed using observation-only development before holdout; no GT/effect/F1 tuning. No algorithm currently approved.

decision_task.action: external manual XMV10 command, not do(v), do(E), do(T_R) or cache assignment
decision_task.policy: candidate constant command from t0, with other manual commands held by their existing controllers; no closed-loop setpoint/override mixing
decision_task.reference_policy: fresh source initialization and unchanged manual command u0; u0 is a known source value, not a validated optimal/physical baseline
decision_task.target: internal reactor temperature T_R readout excluding added sensor noise at terminal H; sensor Y9 reported separately at its evaluate clock
decision_task.mean_loss_definition: (E[T_R(H)|policy_a]-target)^2 + declared action cost; distinct from mean sample squared error
decision_task.choice_nondegeneracy: UNESTABLISHED: actions may share optimum, long propagation and effect magnitude unknown; pure valve tracking is not a substitute

independent_evaluation.estimand: For prespecified distribution of admissible fresh initial states/exogenous histories: E[T_R^a(H)]-E[T_R^reference(H)] under same source and manual policy
independent_evaluation.training_selection_evaluation: disjoint initial-state/seed namespaces and complete trajectory splits; known PR18/19 diagnostics are development only
independent_evaluation.noise: independent-arm mean estimates by default; paired CRN only after call-sequence/exogenous invariance evidence, never seed alone
independent_evaluation.sequential_order: fit/select on development, freeze graphs/models/recommendations+hash, then independent simulator outcomes; no outcome/GT access by recommender
independent_evaluation.failure_policy: separate discovery failure, fit failure, no-path fallback, policy failure and simulator failure; report availability and conditional performance. Predeclared reference-action operational fallback only for model failures; simulator shutdown is an outcome/failure, not silently dropped or assigned invented penalty

analysis.independent_units: independent graph-training trajectory groups nested in valid operating contexts/tasks; one source is not many independent structures
not_independent: algorithm outputs on the same training sample
analysis.common_comparison: same data/splits/preprocessing/model class and tuning rule/actions/cost/horizon/evaluation source for each eligible graph
analysis.separate_mechanisms: graph errors vs coefficient/function error vs path-fallback/policy; fixed-action prediction before optimized-choice analysis; actual-discovery and controlled-error graphs separate
analysis.oracle: diagnostic only if a valid reference exists; currently none approved. A known scalar valve formula is not an oracle full-process GT.

stop_conditions: conditional algebraic exclusion used as global non-edge
holdout/GT leakage or favorable task selection
post-treatment regime selection or silent shutdown removal
